besideDaemon: the beside-daemon case starts Node's daemon (src/standalone/daemon.mjs, MIXDOG_DAEMON_SPAWNED_FOR=session) on the case's data and temp folders, with an unpacked PostgreSQL runtime laid out in <data>/runtime as an installed one is (active-version and the digest stamp that runtime-fetcher.mjs cachedRuntimeDir, :494 and :675, accepts) so it downloads none; the daemon's own network is not tapped and not recorded; the recording keeps whether the daemon still answers a client registering once the exec has ended

exclusions.chunking: consecutive chunks of one stream are joined: the size of one pipe read depends on the OS, only the order of the streams is a fact of the process
